title: What Magnetic Sail Braking Is
definition: Magnetic Sail Braking: slowing interstellar ships with magnetic sails.
description:
Magnetic Sail Braking: slowing interstellar ships with magnetic sails. This is Interstellar & Deep Space Futures at its most ambitious — mag-sail rigs research, braking propulsion engineering and plasma drag operations converging on a single goal: making sail hulls real.

title: Magnetic Sail Braking Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Magnetic Sail Braking: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Magnetic Sail Braking — slowing interstellar ships with magnetic sails.

Phase 1 — Prove (mag-sail rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (braking propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (plasma drag): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (deployment booms): sail hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar medium-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
